study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: Neurocognitive impairment at 2 years of corrected age
finding: In this cohort of preterm neonates, SGA at birth was not associated with significantly different rates of neurocognitive impairment at two years of corrected age.
mod_finding: Infants born small for gestational age (SGA) at preterm gestational ages were more often delivered by cesarean section compared to those appropriately grown (AGA).
